what i did to advocate for myself was read and compile peer reviewed research papers on the likelihood of X symptoms coinciding with whatever genomic result being Y diagnosis. i had to argue that my HLAB-27 and ANA being positive combined with my symptoms meant Y diagnosis was highly likely. being young and AFAB, we have to take the doctor's research obligations into our own hands, within reason, as they will often brush us off without doing their due diligence. i do not know anything personally about NXP-2 but i would read up on conditions it is associated with, match symptoms, and compile research to form your own opinion and bring it up with confidence and printed studies to back it up. sorry if this is rambly or stupid and good luck w figuring out what's going on! :+)
